scripts.build:styles: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('styles.css', 'dist/styles.css'); fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json', 'dist/manifest.json'); if (fs.existsSync('main.js')) { fs.copyFileSync('main.js', 'dist/main.js'); fs.copyFileSync('main.js', 'public/main.js'); } fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json', 'public/manifest.json'); fs.copyFileSync('styles.css', 'public/styles.css');"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run type-check && npm run build:plugin && npm run build:styles
